input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The Agreement runs indefinitely (§ 2: "shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6"), and the only convenience right in § 6(a) is available solely "at any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding". Once an engagement is under way — precisely when an exit matters — Company has no right to terminate for convenience, and § 6(b) is limited to uncured material breach. That absence of any Customer convenience right in an open-ended term fails both the preferred and fallback positions, and the fallback's "end of a term" anchor has no application in an indefinite MSA. We therefore added, at the preferred level, an express Company right to terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, plus an express bar on Contractor convenience termination while any Statement of Work is outstanding (consistent with retained § 6(a), so Contractor's 15-day right survives only when nothing is in progress). Both retained subsections and the Customer-favourable mutual 15-day right are preserved verbatim.

proposal.summary: Add Company termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and bar Contractor convenience termination while a Statement of Work is outstanding.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only permits convenience termination when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we have no exit once an engagement starts. We added a Company right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Contractor cannot walk away mid-engagement.

ops.text: Company may also terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, for any or no reason, upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees pro rata for the period after the effective date of such termination. Contractor may not terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience while any Statement of Work is outstanding.
